name: Corpse Party: Seal ~Eternal Cycle~
source:
[b]Corpse Party: Seal ~Eternal Cycle~[/b] is a RPG Maker VX Ace re-creation of Episode #1; 『Seal』 from [b]Corpse Party: Book of Shadows[/b] for the PlayStation Portable. It was designed by Jackkel Dragon and released on November 7th, 2013.

[Edited from [url=https://corpse-party-fanon.fandom.com/wiki/Corpse_Party:_Seal_~Eternal_Cycle~]Corpse Party Fanon Wiki[/url]]
translation:
[b]尸体派对：封印～永恒的循环～[/b]是RPG Maker VX Ace对第1集的重新创作；“封印”来自[b]尸体派对：暗影之书[/b]适用于PlayStation便携式游戏机。它由Jackkel Dragon设计并于2013年11月7日发布。

[编辑自[url=https://corpse-party-fanon.fandom.com/wiki/Corpse_Party:_Seal_~Eternal_Cycle~]僵尸派对 维基[/url]]
